issues.acceptance: An external focusboard:// activation captured by the registered native replay returns to the app (warm) or boots into the verified state (cold) with the token consumed exactly once, and a reused or expired token lands in the recoverable expired-link state; the paste fallback stays functional.
issues.actual: src-tauri/src/lib.rs implements register_scheme() (writes focusboard.desktop with MimeType x-scheme-handler/focusboard, runs xdg-mime), warm forwarding over focusboard-deeplink.sock, cold-arg PendingDeepLink, and App.tsx auto-verifies take_deep_link tokens without rendering them; capabilities/main.json grants only core:event:default and the CSP is unchanged. However replay.json and capture_evidence.json contain no external link-activation scenario (golden_path unavailable; renderer text is auth-shell only), so the developer-reported warm/cold Xvfb validation is not observable through the registered runtime contract. Paste fallback remains functional at store level; per the plan stop condition the route is reported not-runtime-proven rather than failed.

task_specification.objective: Complete the release-critical PRD section 3 golden path in the running app: replace the Calendar, Focus, and Settings placeholders with real views backed by Reminder and FocusSession entities, an idempotent reminder scheduler delivering through the configured local mail sink, and durable focus-session transitions, so a live driver can perform steps 6-10 with durable data and produce golden-path receipts that no longer report unavailable.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release-critical PRD section 3 path was never built beyond the auth-plus-task-capture slice: src/App.tsx renders Calendar, Focus, and Settings as DeferredSurface placeholders, the Rust command surface has no reminder, focus-session, or calendar commands, and the SQLite schema (v1) has no reminders or focus_sessions tables, so steps 6, 7, 8, and 10 are unperformable in the product. Because the signed-in journey cannot progress, the golden-path probe never finds its renderer states and every bound receipt reports golden_path.state=unavailable, which also blocks live evidence for the otherwise completable steps. The candidate tree is unchanged since loop 3, so this is missing capability, not a regression.

stop_conditions: If the host native replay cannot exercise a new surface even with the observation hooks in place, report that step as blocked or unknown instead of claiming golden-path success.
If the single-session budget cannot complete all three views with their states, descope to reminders and focus sessions and defer the Settings surface to a later loop.
Never add Tauri capabilities, plugins, or CSP changes to implement scheduling or delivery; if one seems required, stop and use the existing Rust-side boundary instead.
If the schema migration cannot be made recoverable and idempotent for existing databases, stop rather than shipping a destructive migration.
Do not modify the four deferred issues' code paths beyond what golden-path work incidentally requires, and give them no dedicated disposition this loop.

strategy.rationale: Ship the missing golden-path capability instead of another evidence pass: the pinned blocker is absent product surface, so no instrument can ever observe the release-critical journey until it exists. This loop pairs direct implementation of the PRD section 5-7 entities and section 8 surfaces with candidate-side observation hooks so the already-registered native replay can drive every step; replay extension and receipt recapture stay host-owned in validation. This is a materially different root-cause strategy from loop 3's deeplink repair and loop 4's evidence-only selection, and it follows the desktop policy's repair-plus-advancement mix.

Calendar renders month and agenda views in the user's timezone with due dates and reminder instants distinct, and a task without a due date stays out of Today.

Focus view drives start, pause, resume, finish, and cancel as durable FocusSession transitions bound to one task; an app restart mid-session never silently completes it, and completing the task marks completion exactly once and updates the Today summary.

At the scheduled instant the Rust scheduler delivers exactly one reminder email per reminder to the local mail sink containing product identity, task title, due context, and a safe link; completing or deleting the task cancels pending reminders, delivery states are visible in Settings, and failed delivery offers a retry action.
Calendar, Focus, and Settings nav items render real views with loading, empty, and error states in the calm editorial style of PRD section 9, with no DeferredSurface placeholder left for them.

The renderer exposes stable accessible names, roles, or data-testid hooks for every golden-path step so the registered native replay can drive register, verify, sign-in, task with reminder, calendar, focus, reminder, and restart, and receipts stop reporting state=unavailable.

Fresh clean npm and cargo builds exit 0, existing cargo tests pass, capabilities/main.json still grants only core:event:default, the CSP string is unchanged, and the validated auth-shell direction is untouched.

evidence_resolution.rationale: find.first-run-gui-drive-missing is evidence-stalled because every bound receipt reports golden_path.state=unavailable: the renderer never reaches the states the golden-path probe checks, because the surfaces and commands the path needs do not exist. The task therefore builds the missing measurement substrate on the candidate side: the real surfaces plus stable accessible names, roles, and queryable IPC state so the already-registered native webdriver replay can drive and assert each step and emit receipts. Rewriting the acceptance is wrong because the live-drive criterion is correct, and waiving a release-critical path is not an option. Extending the replay scenario itself and recapturing receipts are host-owned and live in validation, not in this task.

tasks.instructions: Implement the missing golden-path product surface in the candidate. Data layer: extend the SQLite schema in store.rs with reminders and focus_sessions tables per PRD section 5 via a versioned, recoverable migration, and add reminder time and timezone fields to task creation and editing. Rust boundary: add typed IPC commands for reminders and focus sessions in new modules wired through lib.rs, keeping capabilities and CSP untouched; implement an idempotent reminder scheduler (dedupe key per task and instant; states scheduled, processing, sent, failed, cancelled, skipped) that delivers through the existing configured local mail sink with product identity, task title, due context, and a safe link, cancels pending reminders on task completion or deletion, and offers a retry action for failed delivery. Web layer: replace the DeferredSurface placeholders in App.tsx with real Calendar (month and agenda views, user timezone, due date and reminder instant distinct), Focus (start, pause, resume, finish, cancel tied to one task, durable across restart and refresh, task title and state visible without an opaque fullscreen panel), and Settings (timezone, global and per-task reminder toggles, delivery states with retry) views per PRD sections 6.3, 6.4, 7, and 8, and update Today with overdue tasks, due-today tasks, scheduled focus work, and a completion summary. Keep the mail sink configuration-driven, style new surfaces per PRD section 9, add stable accessible names, roles, or data-testid hooks for each golden-path step, and keep newly added Rust files rustfmt-clean without reformatting deferred legacy files.

risk_note.summary: Highest risk is runtime measurability: even with surfaces implemented, the host replay may fail to drive some step (scheduling a near-term reminder, restart mid-focus), leaving prd_golden_path measurable but again insufficient_evidence.
risk_note.validation: Most likely insufficient: validation.runtime, the live replay over the full path. Mitigate with stable hooks on every step, a schedulable near-term reminder for deterministic firing, and deterministic focus restart behavior; report any unobservable step as blocked rather than passed.
risk_note.why_now: This is the host-pinned blocker, untouched since loop 3, and loop 4 was evidence-only; shipping the surfaces is the only path by which any instrument can observe the release-critical journey.
